title: Set up ControlHome
heading: Welcome home
intro: A few details and your home is ready. It takes about two minutes.

code.label: Setup code
code.title: Confirm it's your server
code.description: Enter the one-time code ControlHome printed when it started. Only someone with access to the server can see it.

database.label: Database
database.title: Connect the database
database.description: ControlHome keeps your home in SQL Server 2025. Tell it which server to use; the connection is tested before anything is saved.

admin.label: Your account
admin.title: Create the administrator
admin.description: This account manages the home. You can add the rest of the household afterwards.

home.label: Your home
home.title: Tell ControlHome about your home
home.description: Used for schedules, sunrise and sunset, and energy costs.

review.label: Review
review.title: Everything look right?
review.description: Check the details below. You can change most of them later.

code.label: Setup code
code.help: It's in the server log (look for “First-run setup code”) and in setup-code.txt in the data folder. Dashes and spaces don't matter.

admin.userNameHelp: Used to sign in, for example ana or ana.souza.
admin.passwordHelp: At least 10 characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.

home.name: Home name
home.locationHelp: Optional. Used for sunrise and sunset; it never leaves your server.
home.locationInsecure: Browsers share location only over HTTPS or on this computer. Type the coordinates instead.
home.locationUnavailable: This browser can't share its location. Type the coordinates instead.
home.locationDenied: Location access was denied. Type the coordinates instead.
home.locationFailed: Couldn't get your location. Type the coordinates instead.
home.languageHelp: For your account and the home's messages.
home.priceHelp: Optional. Lets ControlHome estimate what your devices cost.

database.hostHelp: Host name or IP address, as this ControlHome server reaches it. In Docker, prefer the IP address: .local names usually don't work there.
database.hostInvalid: Enter a host name or an IP address.
database.name: Database
database.nameHelp: ControlHome creates it if the login is allowed to.
database.nameInvalid: Start with a letter and use only letters, digits and _.
database.trustHelp: The connection is always encrypted. Most home servers use SQL Server's own self-signed certificate, so leave this on unless yours has one your network trusts.

reasons.login_failed: SQL Server refused the login. Check the login and the password, and that SQL Server authentication is turned on.
reasons.certificate: The server's certificate isn't trusted. Turn on “Trust the server's certificate”, or give SQL Server a certificate your network trusts.
reasons.unreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check the server and the port, and that SQL Server accepts TCP connections from this server.
reasons.no_database_access: The database exists, but this login can't open it. Use a login that can, or give this one access.
reasons.other: SQL Server refused the connection. The ControlHome log has the details.

createDenied.title: Create the database first
createDenied.description: This login isn't allowed to create databases. Ask an administrator to run the script below, for example as sa in SQL Server Management Studio or sqlcmd, after replacing the password placeholder. It creates the database and a login, ControlHome_App, that can use only this database.
createDenied.next: Then enter ControlHome_App and its password above, and check again.

progress.hint: The first time takes up to a minute. This page continues on its own.
progress.failedDescription: The connection is saved and ControlHome tries again every minute. Fix the problem on the SQL Server and this page continues on its own.

connected.title: Database connected
connected.description: ControlHome is connected to its database and ready for the next step.

database.alreadySetUp: This database already has a home that is set up. Sign in instead.

waiting.title: Getting the database ready
waiting.description: ControlHome is connecting to the database and preparing it. This page continues on its own.
waiting.failedDescription: ControlHome tries again every minute. Check the database server and the ControlHome log; this page continues on its own.
